claim_scope: External llama.cpp speculative configurations executed against our own Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M GGUF and our own mixed 10-prompt category suite, to test whether published structured-data claims generalize. All rows are llama.cpp measurements; no hipEngine row is measured or promoted here.
decision: Laurent's adaptive-draft headline does NOT generalize: on our target and suite, adaptive n_max 7 reaches 1.556x own AR versus 1.668x for a plain n_max 3, i.e. adaptive loses by 6.7%, and his reported 4.69x over bare decode does not appear (best arm of any kind is 1.668x). The MECHANISM does generalize: fixed n_max 7 collapses acceptance to 38.6% and the adaptive controller restores it to 61.7% (+18.8% throughput over fixed n7). Mainline --spec-draft-n-min is NOT an adaptive controller and reproduces fixed n7 exactly. The transferable finding is unrelated to adaptive: fork n_max 3 posts +18.4% MTP throughput over mainline n_max 3 at identical AR, acceptance and draft counts, which is a pure MTP cycle-cost win worth bisecting.

protocol.max_tokens_rationale: 128 rather than 24 so a depth-7 draft can actually amortize; at 24 tokens prefill dominates the complete wall and the test would be rigged against the deep-draft claims under test

laurent_fork.new_flag: --spec-draft-adaptive: size each draft from measured acceptance rather than always drafting --spec-draft-n-max

commands: PYTHONPATH=. python3 scripts/mtp-bench.py --mode server --url http://127.0.0.1:8080 --model llama --prompts-file benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --max-tokens 128 --temperature 0 --no-cache-prompt --out <arm>.json
limitations: Single run per arm, no repeats; no stdev reported.

Mainline is b10438 and the fork is b10681, so the fork-vs-mainline delta confounds Laurent's 337-line change with upstream movement between those builds. Bisecting b10438..b10681 is required to attribute it. AR is controlled (11.35 vs 11.37) so the delta is specific to the MTP path, not a general speedup.
No hipEngine arm was run at max_tokens=128, so these llama.cpp rows must NOT be compared against the hipEngine max_tokens=24 rows in section 3.1; timing boundaries differ materially.
llama.cpp KV is F16 throughout; hipEngine uses BF16.
julianmb and KyaniteLabs distributions were not built; their transferable flags were exercised on mainline where mainline supports them.
next: Bisect llama.cpp b10438..b10681 with the fork_n3 arm to isolate the +18.4% MTP cycle-cost win, then diff the responsible change against the hipEngine speculative cycle. Separately, run a hipEngine max_tokens=128 arm so section 3.1 and section 6.3 share a timing boundary.
